{events.filter(e=>e.date===plannerDate&&(!mine||e.participants?.includes(me))).sort((a,b)=>a.start.localeCompare(b.start)).map(e=>{const conflict=!e.linked&&events.some(x=>!x.linked&&x.id!==e.id&&x.date===e.date&&x.start<e.end&&x.end>e.start&&x.participants?.some((id:string)=>e.participants?.includes(id)));return <div className="event" key={e.id}><div className="event-time">{e.start||'時間待補'}<small>{e.linked?'當地時間':e.end}</small></div><div className="event-body"><EventThumbnail event={e} candidates={candidates} places={places}/><div className="event-content"><div className="card-heading"><h3>{e.name}</h3>{actions(e,e.linked?write&&e.owner===me:edit)}</div><p>{(e.participants||[]).map(name).join('、')||'未指定參加者'}</p>{e.linked&&<span className="tag">預訂連動 · 修改請點編輯</span>}{e.note&&<p>{e.note}</p>}{conflict&&<small className="warning">部分參加者同時有其他安排</small>}<div className="event-actions">{write&&<button className="link" onClick={()=>open('expense',undefined,{name:e.name,date:e.date,eventId:e.id,scope:'shared',participants:e.participants})}>＋ 新增支出</button>}{edit&&!e.linked&&<button className="link" disabled={!nextTripDate(e.date,trip)} onClick={()=>mutate(e,{date:nextTripDate(e.date,trip)})}>移至下一天</button>}</div></div></div></div>})}{!events.some(e=>e.date===plannerDate&&(!mine||e.participants?.includes(me)))&&<div className="empty compact"><Sun size={32}/><h3>這一天，留給你的靈感。</h3><p>從未排程地點加入，或建立自訂活動。</p></div>}
